BiblicalUsage: This word means desertion, a land left empty of its people. Isaiah says the forsaking in the land will be great, when the Lord removes men far away and the cities are left without inhabitant.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that desertion is the fruit of turning away: when a people leaves God, the land empties, and only his mercy brings anyone home.
